dependency_text: The birth choices, closures and counts of LOCAL-COMMUTE; the whole-structure reading of NO-WHOLE-STATE.
objective: At the owner's go-ahead ("Yes, let's continue with 1") on direction 1 of LOCAL-COMMUTE-20261127-001: at each of the 1,177 closures where birth choices attain an odd close, take the birth choices with the most failing pairs (as far from classical as a state allows) and ask whether the closing sign is the same on all of them (forced odd, forced even) or not (free); compare with the least non-classical choices as a control principle. G18 Comparing growth laws. Stop when every frozen prediction is scored.
status: Complete 2026-11-27 (obstruction learned; exact searches; refereed R1, confirmed with fixes, no Block): the birth choices with the most failing pairs force the closing sign at 948 of 1,177 grown closures (one vote per start), even 588 and odd 360; for each score the holding decides the sign, and the occupied-holder-type score reverses it at 199 of 719 closures where both force one; the control is 1 odd, 1,152 even, 24 free; the 173 finished census types (a separate population) split 49 odd, 60 even, 64 free; none of the tested scores forces odd everywhere.
stop_rule: Stop when every frozen prediction is scored; no growth law is changed.
title: A principle for the free sign: do the birth choices with the most failing pairs force it?
